Card Q&A.a: Yes. The effect applies to all of your Digimon that meet the conditions, therefore this effect will also affect Digimon that later enter the battle area as long as they meet the conditions.
Card Q&A.q: After using this card, do level 6 Digimon with the [Machine] trait that are newly played or digivolved in the same turn gain  and  from this card's effect?

Effect: [Main] By trashing 1 card with the [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait from your hand, for the turn, all of your [Machine] trait level 6 Digimon gain ＜Rush＞ and "[On Play] If this Digimon has digivolution cards, ＜Blitz＞."
Security Effect: [Security] By trashing 1 [Cyborg] or [Machine] trait card from your hand, delete 1 of your opponent’s Digimon with a play cost as high as the trashed card's or lower.
